duplicate_policy: pilot_v3 and pilot_v4a describe the same 12 physical tasks; do not count as independent samples. This inventory contains v4a only; v3 is paired initialization comparison, not additional training data.
verification_scope: Read-only byte SHA-256 and checkpoint inventory comparison; witness file membership, request/hash references, resource sums, audit recorded flags, and selection score checked. Physical design hashes and audits not independently recomputed in this inventory; prior replay reports record same-core selected-design audits.
evaluation_cautions: Leave-one-pair-out is conditional pair transfer, not source-independent extrapolation: components, shared substrate, objectives and family seeds may cross the split.

Exact optical-set graph includes substrate and film; all 36 literature tasks form one connected component, while synthetic groups form two other components. Strict source-component cross-validation across these three components would confound synthetic vs literature domain and is not evidence of literature source generalization.
Six objective families repeat shared templates; independent objectives and independent materials are both necessary to assess robust generalization.
All witness N/D are paired finite-budget selected designs; unknown cannot be converted into high-resource or infeasible labels.
